name: @dsh-tui-dev/sqlite-island
description: Self-contained 0.1.1-rc.2 peer island for the retired sqlite session backend. Upstream removed exports it links against after rc.2 (e.g. DEFAULT_PREPARED_SESSION_CACHE_SIZE, PersistenceCoordinator), so it cannot live in the primary 0.1.5 tree: pnpm resolves a root-level dependency's peers from the root context, and the blanket overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml force 0.1.5 there. As a dependency of THIS package its peers resolve from this dependency list instead, which the workspace overrides keep pinned at rc.2. Only scripts/migrate-sessions-to-jsonl.mts consumes it; it never ships.
